1.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.
On the prayer of the learned counsel for the petitioner, the present I.A. stands disposed of as not pressed.

This is an application U/S.483 of BNSS by the petitioner for grant of bail in connection with Khuntuni P.S. Case No.44 of 2025 corresponding to Special G.R. Case No.37 of 2025 pending in the file of learned ADJ-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Cuttack, for commission of offences punishable U/Ss. 376(2)(n)/109 of IPC r/w Section 17 of POCSO Act, on the allegation of abetting the co-accused to commit rape and penetrative sexual assault upon the victim.

4. Heard, Mr. D.D. Naik, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. C. Mohanty, learned Addl.
Public Prosecutor in the matter and perused the record, but none appears for the victim despite being duly informed as intimated by the State.

5. After having considered the rival submissions and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of the offences as alleged against the petitioner vis-- vis the accusations sought to be brought against her and regard being had to the pre-trial detention of the petitioner in custody since Kalpana Surya vs State Of Odisha ... Opposite Party on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156994413/
1 01.05.2025 with submission of charge sheet in the meantime and taking into account the other circumstances on record in entirety including the statement of the victim and keeping in view the status of the petitioner as a lady and applying the first proviso appended to Section 480 of BNSS and the only allegation against the petitioner being for calling the victim to the house of the principal accused, this Court without expressing any view on merits, admits the petitioner to bail.

sentences.text: 6. Hence, the bail application of the petitioner stands allowed and the petitioner is allowed to go on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with two solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin of the case on such terms and conditions as deem fit and proper by it.
7. Accordingly, the BLAPL stand disposed of.

8. Issue urgent certified copy of the order as per Rules.
(G. Satapathy) Judge S.Sasmal
